title: Email triage
instruction: Sort this email into the one folder where it belongs.

labels.name: Reply needed
labels.definition: The sender asks a question or makes a request that expects an answer or action from the reader.

labels.name: Meeting request
labels.definition: The email proposes, schedules, reschedules or invites the reader to a meeting, call or appointment.

labels.name: Invoice or receipt
labels.definition: A bill, payment reminder, receipt, order confirmation or other record of money owed or paid.

labels.name: Promo or newsletter
labels.definition: Bulk marketing, sales offers, cold outreach or a regular newsletter sent to many people.

labels.name: FYI, no action
labels.definition: Information, thanks, status or notices that the reader can simply read and leave.

business_rules: The model only sorts into folders. Code never deletes, archives or auto-replies to any email, whatever the label.
Low-confidence predictions go to a 'Needs a look' folder for a human instead of a label folder.
